Dr. Hassan Farouk is a dedicated General Dentist with a strong focus on preventive and comprehensive dental care.

He believes that regular dental examinations and good oral hygiene are the foundation of a healthy smile. His approach focuses on helping patients understand their oral health while providing comfortable, personalized treatment.

Dr. Farouk works with patients of all ages and is committed to creating a relaxed and welcoming clinical environment.

name: Dr. Peter Kingsley
title: Endodontist
biography:
Dr. Peter Kingsley is an Endodontist with a particular interest in diagnosing and treating conditions affecting the dental pulp and tissues surrounding the tooth.

He specializes in root canal therapy and focuses on preserving natural teeth whenever possible. His careful and methodical approach helps patients receive effective treatment while maintaining their comfort throughout the process.

Dr. Kingsley stays up to date with advances in endodontic techniques and modern dental technology.
